$comment: Data-classification frontmatter schema for the Expert Partners estate. PROVISIONAL pending L1's data-classification ADR (Track E1). The four canonical classes are fixed by the lane partition (lane-L1-foundation.md line 34); L1 ratifies them in an ADR and L6 consumes this file. When L1 lands, this file is the single drop-in point -- the validator code does not change.
_required_in_paths_comment: Glob patterns (relative to repo root) where a classification tag is MANDATORY. Empty today so existing untagged docs do not break commits. L5 populates this per brand repo as content is born tagged; until then, any file that DECLARES a classification is still value-checked everywhere.
_exempt_paths_comment: Never require (or value-check) classification on these even if they match required_in_paths.
